captions.formal: An orange kitten with white patches and darker stripes walks and then runs through a wooded area with leafy green plants and dirt ground towards the camera. The kitten moves through dappled sunlight.
captions.sarcastic: An orange kitten with darker stripes embarks on a heart-stopping adventure, boldly taking a few steps and then sprinting towards the camera through a wooded area. Clearly, a daring feat.
captions.humorous_tech: The orange kitten with darker stripes runs a successful debug session through the wooded area, stepping through foliage and resolving latency issues with its surroundings by sprinting towards the camera.
captions.humorous_non_tech: An orange kitten with darker stripes explores the woods, advancing from a stealthy stalk to a full-on sprint towards the camera, because apparently it had a very important date.
